The plate looks like a paper plate of about 20 cm, and it measures roughly 260 px across in the image, so about 0.77 mm per px... that works out to roughly 13 px per cm.

The plate holds about 12 sausage slices, which look like sliced smoked sausage or andouille. Each slice is about 4 cm across (about 50 px) and about 1.5-2 cm thick. That gives a volume of roughly π × 4 cm × 1.75 cm, or about 22 cm³, which is close to 22 g per slice. Some slices are cut at an angle and look larger, so I'll estimate about 20-25 g each.

12 slices × 22 g is about 265 g. I'll allow a little less, around 240 g.

Smoked sausage runs about 2.8 kcal/g, but this one may be a leaner chicken or vegetarian type at about 2.2 kcal/g. Using roughly 2.5 kcal/g, 240 g comes to about 600 kcal.
